column2: My uncle loves photography and takes pictures of birds every weekend.
column3: 我叔叔熱愛攝影，每個週末都拍鳥。
column5: photo 光 + graph 畫：用光來作畫，就是攝影

column2: The physicist explained why a feather falls slower than a stone on Earth.
column3: 物理學家解釋了為什麼在地球上羽毛比石頭落得慢。
column4: a nuclear physicist (核子物理學家)
column5: physics 物理 + ist 專家：研究物理的人

column2: A pickpocket stole my wallet while the bus was crowded.
column3: 公車擁擠時，一個扒手偷走了我的錢包。
column5: pick 摘取 + pocket 口袋：專門摘走你口袋東西的人

column2: The popularity of bubble tea has spread to many countries.
column3: 珍珠奶茶的受歡迎程度已經傳到許多國家。
column5: popular 受歡迎 + ity：想到流行 pop 歌曲

column2: At the old station, a porter carried our heavy bags to the train.
column3: 在老車站，一位搬運工把我們沉重的行李搬上火車。
column5: port 搬運 (像 transport)＋er：搬東西的人

column2: The fire destroyed nearly every possession the family owned.
column3: 那場火燒毀了這家人幾乎所有的財物。
column5: possess 擁有 + ion：你擁有的東西

column2: During her pregnancy, my aunt ate more fruit and walked every evening.
column3: 懷孕期間，我阿姨多吃水果，每天傍晚散步。
column5: pregnant 懷孕的名詞；肚子裡有小寶貝

column2: In "sit on the chair," the word "on" is a preposition.
column3: 在「sit on the chair」中，「on」是介系詞。
column4: a preposition of place (地方介系詞)
column5: pre 前面 + position 位置：放在名詞前面的字

column2: The mayor's presentation of the award made the winner smile with pride.
column3: 市長頒發獎項的儀式讓得獎者驕傲地微笑。
column5: present 禮物或呈現：把禮物遞到你面前

column2: Volunteers work on the preservation of old temples in the town.
column3: 志工致力於保存鎮上的古廟。
column5: pre 事先 + serve 保持：事先顧好才不壞

column2: Washing hands often is the best way to ensure prevention of colds.
column3: 常洗手是預防感冒的最佳方法。
column5: pre 先 + vent 來：病還沒來就先擋下來

column2: Teenagers need some privacy, so please knock before you enter their room.
column3: 青少年需要一點隱私，所以進他們房間前請先敲門。
column4: invade someone's privacy (侵犯某人隱私)
column5: private 私人的名詞；房門關起來是自己的小天地

column2: Rice production in the region has doubled in the last ten years.
column3: 這個地區的稻米產量在過去十年增加了一倍。
column5: pro 向前 + duce 引導：把東西帶到眼前，就是生產

column2: In "Mia loves her cat," the pronoun "her" replaces Mia's name.
column3: 在「Mia loves her cat」中，代名詞「her」取代了米雅的名字。
column5: pro 代替 + noun 名詞：代替名詞的字

column2: The town's prosperity grew after the new factory brought jobs.
column3: 新工廠帶來工作機會後，小鎮的繁榮成長了。
column5: 諧音「皮囊斯別瑞地」→ 荷包鼓鼓，生活很興旺

column2: A school psychologist talked with the students about managing exam stress.
column3: 學校心理學家和學生談如何面對考試壓力。
column4: a child psychologist (兒童心理學家)
column5: psycho 心靈 + logist 學者：研究心的人

column2: She chose to study psychology because she wants to understand why people feel afraid.
column3: 她選擇主修心理學，因為她想了解人為什麼會害怕。
column5: psycho 心靈 + logy 學問：心的學問；p 不發音

column2: The publisher printed ten thousand copies of the children's storybook.
column3: 出版商印了一萬本這本兒童故事書。
column5: publish 出版 + er：把書公開給大家的公司

column2: Three police cars sped off in pursuit of the stolen truck.
column3: 三輛警車急駛而去，追擊那輛被偷的卡車。
column5: pur 向前 + suit：像跟在後面穿著西裝緊追不放

column2: Heavy rainfall in July filled the reservoirs to the top.
column3: 七月的豐沛降雨量讓水庫都滿了。
column5: rain 雨 + fall 落下：落下的雨量

column2: Grandma gave me her recipe for tomato soup, written on a small card.
column3: 奶奶把她的番茄湯食譜寫在小卡上給我。
column5: 諧音「雷西皮」：看食譜才不會把廚房炸成雷

column2: After ten years apart, her facial recognition of him was instant.
column3: 分開十年後，她一眼就認出了他。
column5: re 再 + cognize 知道：再次知道是誰，就是認出

column2: The park offers cheap recreation for families, like boating and picnics.
column3: 這座公園提供家庭平價的娛樂，例如划船和野餐。
column5: re 再 + create 創造：再創造活力，就是休閒

column2: The essay needs a reference to the book it quotes from.
column3: 這篇文章需要註明所引用書籍的出處。
column4: cite a reference (列出參考文獻)
column5: refer 指向 + ence：指向哪本書，就是出處

column2: We could see the reflection of the mountains in the calm lake.
column3: 我們看得見群山在平靜湖面上的倒影。
column5: re 回 + flect 彎：光線彎回來，就是反射

column2: The refugee carried only a small bag when she crossed the border.
column3: 這名難民越過邊界時只帶了一個小包。
column5: 諧音「瑞福吉」：離開家園找避風港的人

column2: Online registration closes on Friday, so sign up for the camp today.
column3: 線上報名星期五截止，所以今天就為營隊登記吧。
column5: register 登記簿 + ion：把名字寫進簿子

column2: A safety regulation says all passengers must wear a seat belt.
column3: 一項安全規定要求所有乘客都必須繫上安全帶。
column5: reg 規則 + ulation：照著 rule 來管理

column2: After the rejection of his first story, he kept writing and tried again.
column3: 他的第一篇故事被退回後，他繼續寫作並再次嘗試。
column5: re 回 + ject 丟：丟回給你，就是退回

column2: The relaxation of the dress code made summer at the office more comfortable.
column3: 服裝規定的放寬讓辦公室的夏天更舒服。
column5: relax 放鬆 + ation：繃緊的規定放鬆下來

column2: Learning a poem by heart takes lots of repetition.
column3: 把一首詩背下來需要大量的反覆練習。
column5: repeat 重複 + ition：一遍又一遍

column2: Every class sends one student to the council for fair representation.
column3: 每個班級選派一名學生進入委員會，以確保公平的代表權。
column5: represent 代表 + ation：派人來代替大家發言

column2: A researcher at the museum spent years studying ancient pottery.
column3: 博物館的一名研究員花了數年研究古代陶器。
column5: research 研究 + er：做研究的人

column2: The villagers put up strong resistance against the plan to build a dam.
column3: 村民對興建水壩的計畫強烈反抗。
column5: resist 抵抗 + ance：你推我就推回去

column2: There is a new restriction on how many bags you can carry onboard.
column3: 現在對可帶上機的行李數量有了新的限制。
column5: re 後 + strict 嚴格：往後拉緊，就是限制

column2: After one revision, her essay became shorter and much clearer.
column3: 經過一次修訂，她的文章變得更短也更清楚。
column5: re 再 + vision 看：再看一遍，就能修正

column2: Their romance began at a summer camp and lasted for years.
column3: 他們的戀情始於夏令營，並持續了好幾年。
column5: 諧音「肉慢」：愛情要慢慢談，不要急

column2: The salesman showed us three different washing machines at the store.
column3: 店裡的售貨員向我們展示了三台不同的洗衣機。
column5: sales 銷售 + man 男人：賣東西的先生

column2: A friendly salesperson helped me find shoes that fit my wide feet.
column3: 一位親切的店員幫我找到適合我寬腳的鞋子。
column5: sales 銷售 + person 人：男女都適用，最中性

column2: The saleswoman wrapped the gift in blue paper and tied a red ribbon.
column3: 女店員用藍紙包好禮物，繫上紅絲帶。
column5: sales 銷售 + woman 女人：賣東西的小姐
